column1: Dar es Salaam in Tanzania is one of the fastest growing cities in Africa.
column2: 坦桑尼亚的达累斯萨拉姆是非洲发展最快的城市之一。

column1: Its population has increased eightfold since 1980 and swells by half a million people every year.
column2: 自1980年以来，这座城市的人口已增至原来的八倍，而且每年还要增加50万人。

column1: United Nations projections anticipate it will become a megacity within seven years as its population passes 10 million, reaching 13.4 million by 2035.
column2: 联合国预测，该市人口将在七年内突破1,000万，跻身特大城市之列，到2035年更将达到1,340万。

column1: Daniel Hoornweg for the Global Cities Institute forecasts the city could be home to an incredible 73.7 million people by 2100.
column2: 丹尼尔·霍恩韦格为全球城市研究所作出的预测显示，到2100年，该市居民人数可能达到惊人的7,370万。
column3: Global Cities Institute|全球城市研究所
column5: could be home to|可能容纳……居民

column1: Today, four out of five of its people live in single-storey informal settlements on the spreading edges of the city, where the journey to and from the centre regularly takes over two hours.
column2: 如今，每五名居民就有四人住在不断向外扩张的城区边缘，那里的非正规住区以单层房屋为主。从那里往返市中心，路上经常要花两个多小时。
column3: four out of five|五分之四
column6: spreading edges|不断扩张的边缘地带

column1: It can be longer if rain turns the dirt roads to mud.
column2: 如果雨水把土路变得泥泞，路上花的时间还会更长。
column3: can be longer|可能花更长时间

column1: Even in the middle of the day, traffic frequently slows to a stop without warning.
column2: 即使在中午，车流也常常毫无预兆地慢下来，直至完全停住。
column3: in the middle of the day|在中午
column6: slows to a stop|逐渐减速直至停住

column1: It is not unusual for cars and minibuses to queue for 20 minutes at a key intersection.
column2: 轿车和小巴在重要路口排队等上20分钟，是常有的事。

column1: A single suburban rail line serves residents in a few areas to the south but is tiny in the context of the wider city.
column2: 仅有的一条市郊铁路线能为南部少数地区的居民服务，但放眼全市，它的覆盖范围微不足道。
column7: in the context of|放在……的背景下

column1: Outside the centre many rely on boda boda (motorbike taxis) to navigate the narrow side streets and potholed mud roads that make up much of the metropolis.
column2: 市中心以外，许多人靠当地称为 boda boda 的摩托车出租服务出行，穿过狭窄的小街和坑坑洼洼的泥路；这类道路遍布城内的大部分区域。
column4: boda boda|当地的摩托车出租服务
column8: potholed mud roads|坑坑洼洼的泥路

column1: Their safety record is scandalous.
column2: 这些摩托车出租车的安全记录糟糕得令人震惊。
column4: scandalous|adj. 糟糕得令人震惊的

column1: Dar es Salaam's reliance on four arterial roads into the city is a legacy of the colonial government that planned the city at the start of the 20th century to cater for a population of 35,000.
column2: 达累斯萨拉姆依赖四条进城干道，这是殖民政府留下的格局。20世纪初，殖民当局规划这座城市时，是按供3.5万人生活的需要设计的。

column1: Most of the current growth is made up of young people arriving from the countryside to find work, and as the population has exploded, Dar es Salaam has grown around those four highways.
column2: 如今新增人口大多是从农村进城找工作的年轻人。随着人口激增，达累斯萨拉姆也沿那四条公路扩展。

column1: Nearly all the expansion is happening on the periphery, and nearly all takes place informally without any agreed strategy.
column2: 城市扩展几乎全部发生在外围，而且几乎都自发进行，并没有各方共同商定的规划。

column1: But Dar es Salaam is pinning its hopes on a solution that could offer a different model for Africa's megacities, giving them an alternative to a future controlled by the private car.
column2: 不过，达累斯萨拉姆正把希望寄托在一种解决方案上，期望它能为非洲的特大城市提供另一种发展模式，使它们有机会摆脱私家车主导的未来。
column3: pinning its hopes on|把希望寄托在……上
column4: offer a different model|提供不同的模式
column6: an alternative to|……之外的另一种选择

column1: Unlike many cities on the continent, Dar es Salaam isn't trying to build a metro.
column2: 与非洲许多城市不同，达累斯萨拉姆并没有打算建地铁。

column1: It has chosen a less exciting but cheaper and more achievable method: the bus.
column2: 它选的是一种没那么令人兴奋、却更便宜也更容易实现的办法：公交车。
column3: less exciting|没那么令人兴奋的

column1: The DART bus rapid transit (BRT) system runs on bus lanes separated from other traffic, mostly in the middle of the road to reduce stoppages.
column2: 达累斯萨拉姆快速公交系统（DART）使用与其他车辆隔开的公交专用道。这些车道大多设在道路中央，以减少行车停顿。

column1: Ticket purchase and control takes place at stations prior to boarding and the buses are step-free, which means the entire route is accessible to people using wheelchairs or who are travelling with baby buggies.
column2: 乘客在上车前就已在车站购票、验票，公交车也采用无台阶设计。因此，使用轮椅或推婴儿车出行的人可以无障碍地乘完全程。
column3: ticket purchase and control|购票和验票

column1: 'The new buses are much, much better,' says Paulas George, a young IT worker.
column2: “新公交车好太多了。”年轻的信息技术从业者保拉斯·乔治说。
column5: young IT worker|年轻的信息技术从业者

column1: He takes the bus every day and it has cut his journey time by two-thirds.
column2: 他每天都乘公交车，如今路上花的时间缩短了三分之二。

column1: He says it is not perfect, though, complaining that drivers often refuse to turn on the air conditioning to save fuel.
column2: 不过，他说新服务也有不足，抱怨司机常常为了省油而不肯开空调。

column1: That is not the only problem.
column2: 问题还不止这一个。
column3: not the only problem|并非唯一的问题

column1: A shortage of buses after a serious flood at the main depot during the rainy season means the system is carrying 200,000 people a day – half the expected capacity.
column2: 雨季里，主要公交车场遭遇严重洪灾，造成车辆短缺。整个系统现在每天运送20万人次，仅为预期运力的一半。
column3: shortage of buses|公交车辆短缺
column7: half the expected capacity|预期运力的一半

column1: Smartcards can't be used as the mechanical readers aren't working either, forcing passengers to buy individual paper tickets for every journey.
column2: 由于读卡机也出了故障，智能卡无法使用，乘客每次出行都得单独买一张纸票。
column7: individual paper tickets|单次纸质车票

column1: Each is printed with a scannable QR code, but there are no scanners.
column2: 每张车票都印着可供扫描的二维码，现场却没有扫描器。

column1: Staff stand by the gates and tear tickets as people enter.
column2: 工作人员守在入口闸门旁，乘客进站时便手工撕票。
column4: by the gates|在入口闸门旁

column1: As a result, queues are considerable at peak times.
column2: 因此，高峰时段经常排起很长的队伍。

column1: Morogoro Road to the north-west of the city was phase I of the BRT project.
column2: 快速公交一期工程位于通往城市西北部的莫罗戈罗路。

column1: Phases II and III will install bus lanes along Nyerere Road to the south-west and Kilwa Road to the south.
column2: 二期和三期将分别在通往西南部的尼雷尔路和通往南部的基尔瓦路铺设公交专用道。
column3: Phases II and III|二期与三期工程

column1: Construction on both routes is due to start imminently.
column2: 两条线路都即将动工。
column5: is due to start|按计划即将开始

column1: Phase IV, towards Bagamoyo in the north, is in the preliminary design stage.
column2: 通往北部巴加莫约的四期工程正处于初步设计阶段。
column6: preliminary design stage|初步设计阶段

column1: 'Much of the city will have access to a world-class transport system within the space of a few years,' says Chris Kost, the Africa director of ITDP (the Institute for Transportation and Development Policy).
column2: “短短几年之内，城市大部分地区就能用上世界一流的交通系统。”交通与发展政策研究所（ITDP）非洲区负责人克里斯·科斯特说。
column3: much of the city|城市的大部分区域
column6: within the space of|在短短……之内
column8: Transportation and Development Policy|交通与发展政策

column1: All phases are being planned to high standards and, once complete, a third of city residents will be within a short walk of the BRT network.
column2: 各期工程都按高标准规划。项目全部完工后，全市将有三分之一的居民只需步行一小段距离就能搭上快速公交。
column7: within a short walk of|距……仅几步路

column1: The ITDP regrets Africa's obsession with metros.
column2: 交通与发展政策研究所对非洲城市一味热衷建造地铁的做法感到惋惜。

column1: 'With a metro, an international firm will often just parachute in its own system,' says Kost.
column2: “建地铁时，国际公司往往会直接把自己的一套系统搬过来。”科斯特说。
column5: its own system|它自己的一套系统

column1: 'Bus rapid transit allows existing stakeholders to get involved.
column2: “快速公交可以让当地原有的各方都参与进来。
column4: existing stakeholders|原有的利益相关方

column1: That's what we did in Dar es Salaam and what we're planning in Nairobi, where the bus bodies will be built in the city and local operators will look after tickets, fare collection and IT ...Bus rapid transit has been transformational for Dar es Salaam.
column2: 我们在达累斯萨拉姆就是这样做的，在内罗毕也正打算这么做。内罗毕的公交车身将在本地制造，票务、票款收取和信息技术则由当地运营商负责……快速公交已经彻底改变了达累斯萨拉姆的交通面貌。

column1: For millions of people in African cities, this is their best hope of ever being connected.'
column2: 对于非洲城市里的数百万人而言，这是他们有朝一日能接入公共交通网的最大希望。”
column5: ever being connected|终有机会接入交通网
